name: EverGreen Treated Wood (DBA Iowa Wood Preservers)
old_description: We offer a diverse line of treatment products that allow us to treat and manufacture lumber products for various uses and applications.
about:
EverGreen Treated Wood, doing business as Iowa Wood Preservers, operates from Oskaloosa, Iowa, with additional facilities in Sutton, Nebraska, and Willmar, Minnesota. The family‑owned company was founded by Vic Sowl, who remains listed as founder, and is now led by his son Nick Sowl as president.

The company pressure‑treats and manufactures lumber products for wholesale distribution across the Midwest. Its treatment lines include CCA for commercial and agricultural use, MCA (Lifewood) for residential exterior applications, and Pyro‑Guard fire‑retardant lumber and plywood for enclosed structural work. Value‑added services include kiln drying after treatment (KDAT), precision end trimming (PET), notched runner fabrication for shed foundations, and V‑groove paneling for agricultural and utility buildings. Three regional plants support wholesale shipments, though total headcount and annual volume are not disclosed.

EverGreen serves agricultural, residential, fire‑protection, government and utility, marine, and wood‑foundation markets. Customers include wholesale lumber yards, builders, and contractors seeking treated framing, decking, guardrail, and foundation materials. The company also supplies marine‑grade plywood and fire‑retardant products for code‑driven projects.

Management emphasizes its family‑owned structure and Midwest footprint as a differentiator, stating that local ownership drives a commitment to durable, cost‑effective wood preservation and responsive customer service.
